title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer
description:
Senior Machine Learning Engineer

£782/day (Inside IR35) | 12-Month Contract | London (2 Days Onsite)

Overview

The Clinical Platforms team is seeking a Senior Machine Learning Engineer to help build and scale AI-powered solutions that support large-scale medical imaging initiatives across the business.

This is a highly technical engineering role sitting at the intersection of Machine Learning, Computer Vision, Cloud Engineering and Data Platforms. You'll be responsible for developing, deploying and maintaining production-grade machine learning systems that enable researchers and scientists to work with complex imaging datasets and AI-driven workflows.

The team is looking for a hands-on engineer with strong Python, Machine Learning and Google Cloud Platform (GCP) experience who can take ownership of technical solutions from concept through to production deployment.

What You'll Be Doing
  • Designing, building and deploying scalable machine learning and computer vision solutions
  • Developing and maintaining ML infrastructure supporting medical imaging and AI workloads
  • Building end-to-end ML pipelines, including data processing, training, validation and deployment workflows
  • Working with large-scale imaging datasets within cloud-based environments
  • Deploying, monitoring and optimising production machine learning models
  • Developing model architectures and supporting systems for complex imaging use cases
  • Monitoring, troubleshooting and improving model performance and production systems
  • Collaborating with engineers, researchers and data scientists across multiple projects
Key Skills & ExperienceEssential
  • Strong commercial experience with Python development
  • Experience building and deploying machine learning solutions into production
  • Strong Google Cloud Platform (GCP) experience
  • Experience designing and delivering production-grade ML platforms and workflows
  • Strong understanding of systems architecture and cloud infrastructure
  • Experience building end-to-end machine learning solutions
  • Proven track record delivering machine learning and engineering projects into production
Highly Desirable
  • Computer Vision or Image Processing experience
  • Experience developing and deploying Machine Learning models at scale
  • Experience working with image datasets in production environments
  • PyTorch, OpenCV, NumPy or related technologies
  • BigQuery and wider GCP ecosystem experience
  • Familiarity with AI-assisted development tools such as Cursor, Claude Code or GitHub Copilot
Nice to Have
  • Medical imaging experience
  • DICOM or PACS exposure
  • Healthcare, biotech or pharmaceutical industry experience
Ideal Background

We're open to candidates from a variety of backgrounds, including:

  • Senior Machine Learning Engineers
  • Machine Learning Platform Engineers
  • Computer Vision Engineers
  • AI Engineers
  • Applied Scientists
  • Research Engineers
  • Software Engineers with strong Machine Learning and Cloud Engineering experience

The key requirement is strong, hands-on commercial machine learning engineering experience and the ability to design, build and support complex production systems.

Why Join?
  • Work on cutting-edge AI and medical imaging initiatives
  • Join a highly technical engineering team Clinical Platforms function
  • Contribute to AI platforms supporting drug discovery and clinical research
  • Opportunity to work across Machine Learning, Computer Vision and Cloud Engineering projects
  • Long-term 12-month contract with strong extension potential
Contract Details
  • Role: Senior Machine Learning Engineer
  • Contract Length: 12 Months
  • Rate: Up to £782/day
  • IR35 Status: Inside IR35
  • Location: London
  • Working Pattern: 2 Days Onsite Per Week

If your background sits across Machine Learning, Computer Vision, AI Engineering and Cloud Platforms, I'd be happy to share further details.
